users.approveMessage: Are you sure you want to approve {{name}}?
users.rejectMessage: Are you sure you want to reject {{name}}? This will permanently delete their account.
users.disableMessage: Are you sure you want to disable {{name}}? They will no longer be able to access the system.
users.cannotChangeOwnAdmin: You cannot change your own admin status
users.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to permanently delete {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.

settings.aiKillSwitchDesc: Master switch to disable ALL AI features. When enabled, no data is sent to AI providers.
settings.lockedByEnv: Locked by environment variable (AI_KILL_SWITCH). Change .env to modify.
settings.aiWarning: AI features are enabled. Depending on your AI provider configuration, data may be sent to third-party services for processing.
settings.requireApprovalDesc: New users must be approved by an admin before they can access the application.
settings.passkeyAuthDesc: Allow users to register and sign in with passkeys (biometrics, hardware keys) for passwordless authentication.
settings.passwordLoginDesc: Allow users to sign in with email/username + password. When disabled, only passkey authentication is available.
settings.emailRecoveryOff: Email recovery is also OFF — users without a passkey have no way to recover access.
settings.emailRecoveryDesc: When password login is enabled, this powers the "Forgot password?" email flow. When disabled, it powers magic-link passkey recovery.
settings.noEmailConfigured: No outbound email is configured (SMTP settings missing). This toggle has no effect until email is set up.
settings.requireEmailDesc: Require users to provide an email address during registration. Needed for password resets and notifications.
settings.passwordPolicyDesc: Configure password requirements for user registration and password resets.
settings.siteUrlDesc: Public URL used in email links and notifications. Must include protocol (https://).
settings.siteUrlHint: Used in password reset emails and welcome notifications
settings.legacyMcpDesc: Show the "Legacy API Keys" section in project settings for tools that do not support OAuth. When disabled (default), only OAuth-based MCP connections are offered.
settings.mcpAccessDesc: Allow external tools to connect to projects via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The AI kill switch takes precedence: when it is on, MCP is disabled regardless of this setting.
settings.mcpKillSwitchOverrides: The AI kill switch is on, which disables MCP regardless of this toggle.

killSwitchDialog.title: Enable AI Features?
killSwitchDialog.warning: Warning: Disabling the AI kill switch will enable AI features on this server.
killSwitchDialog.consequences: Depending on how your AI providers are configured, this could result in:
killSwitchDialog.consequence1: User content being sent to third-party AI services
killSwitchDialog.consequence2: Data being processed by external providers (OpenAI, OpenRouter, etc.)
killSwitchDialog.recommendation: Recommendation: If privacy is a concern, consider using self-hosted AI providers or keeping the kill switch enabled.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.noAnnouncementsHint: Create your first announcement to notify users about updates.
announcements.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete "{{title}}"? This action cannot be undone.

announcementEditor.showToUnauthHint: When enabled, this announcement will appear on the home page for visitors who are not logged in.
announcementEditor.titleMaxLength: Title must be 200 characters or less
announcementEditor.contentMaxLength: Content must be 10,000 characters or less

email.enableEmailDesc: Enable transactional email sending (welcome emails, password resets). Requires SMTP configuration below.
email.passwordHint: Leave blank to keep the current password

github.githubSignInDesc: Allow users to sign in with their GitHub account.
github.step1b: Click OAuth Apps → New OAuth App
github.step1d: Application name: Your Inkweld instance name
github.step1h: Copy the Client ID shown on the next page
github.step1i: Click Generate a new client secret and copy it immediately
github.step2Desc: Paste the Client ID and Client Secret from GitHub below.
github.secretHint: Leave blank to keep the current secret
github.callbackHint: Only change this if using a reverse proxy with a different URL
github.step3Desc: Credentials are configured. Toggle the switch above to enable GitHub sign-in for your users.
github.step3Active: GitHub sign-in is active. Users will see a "Sign in with GitHub" button on the login page.

aiProviders.title: AI Providers
aiProviders.description: Configure API keys for AI service providers. These keys are shared across all AI features including image generation and text generation.
aiProviders.deleteKeyConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the {{provider}} API key?

aiSettings.disabledByEnv: AI features are disabled by the AI_KILL_SWITCH environment variable.
aiSettings.killSwitchEnabled: The AI Kill Switch is enabled. All AI features are currently disabled.
aiSettings.killSwitchWarning: While the kill switch is enabled, AI image generation and AI linting features will not be available to users. Disable the kill switch in Settings to use these features.
aiSettings.goToSettings: Go to Settings to disable Kill Switch
aiSettings.imageGenerationDesc: Enable or disable AI-powered image generation
aiSettings.enableImageGenerationDesc: Allow users to generate images using AI providers
aiSettings.imageProfilesDesc: Configure which AI models are available for image generation
aiSettings.imageProfilesHelp: Image profiles define which AI models users can select when generating images. Each profile specifies a provider, model, and supported sizes.
aiSettings.noProfilesHint: Create an image model profile to enable image generation for users.
aiSettings.customSizesDesc: Define custom resolution profiles for image generation
aiSettings.customSizesHelp: Custom sizes are available in addition to the standard sizes offered by each provider. Users can select these when generating images.
aiSettings.atLeastOneModel: At least one model must be enabled
aiSettings.deleteProfileConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the profile "{{name}}"?

aiText.disabledByEnv: AI features are disabled by the AI_KILL_SWITCH environment variable.
aiText.killSwitchEnabled: The AI Kill Switch is enabled. All AI features are currently disabled.
aiText.killSwitchWarning: While the kill switch is enabled, AI text generation features (linting, prompt optimization) will not be available to users. Disable the kill switch in Settings to use these features.
aiText.goToSettings: Go to Settings to disable Kill Switch
aiText.textGenerationDesc: Global settings for AI-powered text generation (linting, prompt optimization)
aiText.enableTextGenerationDesc: Allow AI text generation features like linting and prompt optimization
aiText.defaultProviderDesc: Provider used when none is specified
aiText.aiLintingDesc: Configure the AI model and prompt used for document linting
aiText.lintModelDesc: Model used for AI-powered grammar and style checking
aiText.customLintPromptDesc: Customize the system prompt sent to the AI for linting. Leave empty to use the default prompt.
aiText.customLintPromptPlaceholder: You are an expert editor helping to improve creative writing...
aiText.imagePromptOptimizationDesc: Configure the AI model that optimizes worldbuilding data into image generation prompts
aiText.optimizationModelDesc: Model used to transform raw worldbuilding data into optimized image prompts
aiText.customOptTemplateDesc: Customize the system prompt for transforming worldbuilding data into image prompts. Leave empty to use the default template.
aiText.customOptTemplatePlaceholder: You are an expert at creating prompts for AI image generation...
aiText.noProvidersDesc: Configure API keys to enable text models
aiText.noProvidersHelp: Configure API keys for text providers (OpenAI, OpenRouter, or Anthropic) on the AI Providers page.

imageAudits.title: Image Generation Audits
imageAudits.auditsWillAppear: Image generation audits will appear here

imageProfile.nameHint: A user-friendly name for this profile
imageProfile.selectTypeFirst: Select a model type above, then search here
imageProfile.noModelsFound: No models found. Type to search or check provider API key.
imageProfile.modelSearchHint: Search and select from available models
imageProfile.modelIdHint: Enter the model identifier from your Stable Diffusion API
